summary: Malheur NF summit lookout: a 20 ft pole L-4 tower built in 1931 and removed or destroyed in the 1950s; a former lookout site with a hike to the top.

facts.status_note: Removed in the 1950s per the register; firelookout.com says destroyed in the 1950s

access.note: Oregon Hikers lists a hike to the summit; no source mentions a closure

visit.trail_note: Oregon Hikers lists Lookout Mountain via Sunshine Flat, 7.4 miles with 1,750 ft of gain, along a long abandoned road

events.note: Given only as the 1950s. The register says removed; firelookout.com says destroyed; the Rex page says removed
Registered with the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on June 24, 2011

evidence.supports: Built in 1931 as a 20-foot pole L-4 tower; removed in the 1950s
evidence.quote: Built in 1931, this 20' pole L-4 tower was removed in the 1950s.

evidence.supports: Site lies in the Malheur National Forest
Site lies in Baker County, Oregon
Rex's page lists the site as removed
Former lookout site, between two wilderness areas
evidence.quote: Lookout Mountain is a former lookout site and prominent peak
between the Strawberry Mountain Wilderness (to the west) and the Monument Rock Wilderness (to the east)

evidence.supports: Hike follows a long abandoned road to a peak
evidence.quote: Hike a long abandoned road to a peak with far-reaching views

sources.title: Lookout Mountain Lookout Site-MNF
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites register, Forest Fire Lookout Association

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the tower was removed in the 1950s; firelookout.com says it was destroyed in the 1950s. Both give the same decade, so the story uses the decade and gives both wordings.

notes_for_editor: Two strong sources (the register and firelookout.com) agree on the 1931 pole L-4 tower; the Rex page only confirms removal and gives the survey location. No source describes what remains on the summit today. The access level 'public' is inferred from the Oregon Hikers hike listing, not stated by any source, so treat it as medium confidence. The Oregon Hikers page is for this summit by title and location; the Umatilla NF Lookout Mountain (oregonlookouts lookout-mountain4) is a different site and was not used. The brief's height is not in any source as metres, so no height_m was set.
